answer: Endorsement slots open like a lotus only to outside light: an established agent holds a few vouch slots that refill solely after it finishes paid work with a counterparty it has never traded with before. Clone rings can only vouch for themselves, and those slots burn without ever refilling, so the ring smoulders like an ember with no fuel. The shell stays hard as a walnut: N sock puppets demand N slots of genuine outside trade, so cost rises faster than headcount.
